name: ntr_top_performer
xsql:
SELECT 
    Max(Case When rn = 1 Then rn End) as top_performer_1_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then name End), '') as top_performer_1_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_1_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_1_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 2 Then rn End) as top_performer_2_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then name End), '') as top_performer_2_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_2_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_2_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 3 Then rn End) as top_performer_3_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then name End), '') as top_performer_3_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_3_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_3_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 4 Then rn End) as top_performer_4_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then name End), '') as top_performer_4_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_4_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_4_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 5 Then rn End) as top_performer_5_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then name End), '') as top_performer_5_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_5_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_5_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 6 Then rn End) as top_performer_6_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then name End), '') as top_performer_6_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_6_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_6_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 7 Then rn End) as top_performer_7_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then name End), '') as top_performer_7_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_7_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_7_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 8 Then rn End) as top_performer_8_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then name End), '') as top_performer_8_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_8_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_8_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 9 Then rn End) as top_performer_9_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then name End), '') as top_performer_9_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_9_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_9_pct,
    
    Max(Case When rn = 10 Then rn End) as top_performer_10_rank,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then name End), '') as top_performer_10_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_performer_10_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then pct End), 0.0) as top_performer_10_pct

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name,
        payout,
        CAST(CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (payout * 100.0 / max_payout) END AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS pct,
        Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY payout DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            name,
            payout,
            Max(payout) OVER () as max_payout -- Safe window execution on static fields
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) AS name, 
                SUM(p.amount) AS payout
            FROM xactly.xc_payment p
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
                ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
                
            -- FIXED: Tie the active participant lookup perfectly to the payment period to prevent tripling
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period active_per
                ON p.period_id = active_per.period_id
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                ON part.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                AND CAST(active_per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                AND CAST(active_per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pta.title_name AS title_name
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                    ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                    ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                    ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
            
            INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
               AND pta.title_name = m.title
               
            WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
              AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND m.category = 'ONC'
              
              -- Apply the region filter logic to the correctly joined active participant
              AND ('ALL' IN (:p_region) OR pa_active.region IN (:p_region))
              
            GROUP BY 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) 
        ) BaseSums
    ) WindowSums
) RankedData
WHERE rn <= 10
